const item=$input.first().json||{};if(item.ok!==true)return [{json:item}];
const scope=item.itineraryMode==='half_day'?'short overview, reduced facts, minimal packing and 2-3 local tips':item.itineraryMode==='full_day'?'full-day overview, day-pack guidance and practical local tips':item.itineraryMode==='multi_day'?'full overview, accommodation/meals context, full packing, health and safety': 'destination overview, spot-oriented practical guidance and general packing';
const verified=(item.verifiedVenueSet||[]).map(v=>v.name);
const prompt=`Write polished final copy for a travel brochure in ${item.outputLanguage==='en'?'English':'Indonesian'}.
Mode is authoritative: ${item.itineraryMode}. Scope: ${scope}.
Return ONLY JSON with exactly these root keys: overview, practical, closing.
overview exactly has summary, quickFacts, routeSummary, highlights.
routeSummary MUST be a JSON array of 2-6 short plain text strings (each just a sentence describing one stage of the route in order) — never objects, never {day,title,note} pairs, and never a single combined string or paragraph. Each stage is its own array element.
quickFacts exactly has scope, bestSeason, pace, themes.
Each highlight exactly has icon, title, note. icon MUST be one of exactly these 7 values: transport, sightseeing, food, activity, rest, accommodation, free — never an emoji, never any other word.
practical exactly has included, notIncluded, whatToBring, localTips, healthSafety, emergencyContacts.
Each localTips item exactly has topic and note. Each emergencyContacts item exactly has label and value.
closing exactly has closingNote and disclaimer.
Use the reconciled skeleton context; do not add venue names outside the verified set. Verified named set: ${JSON.stringify(verified)}.
No prices, currency values, opening hours, ticket prices, ratings, reviews, booking CTAs, scarcity, or OTA-style feature checklists. Do not claim exact times. Keep guidance practical and honest; never invent a fact.
Context:
${JSON.stringify({agencyName:item.agencyName,agencyContact:item.agencyContact,destination:item.destination,region:item.region,country:item.country,tripTitle:item.tripTitle,itineraryMode:item.itineraryMode,durationDays:item.durationDays,scopeLabel:item.scopeLabel,paceLevel:item.paceLevel,themes:item.themes,verifiedVenueSet:item.verifiedVenueSet,schedule:item.schedule,spots:item.spots})}`;
return [{json:{...item,finalCopyRequiredKeys:['overview','practical','closing'],requestBody:{model:'openai/gpt-5.6-luna',reasoning:{effort:'medium'},input:[{role:'system',content:[{type:'input_text',text:'You write useful travel guidance. Return strict JSON only and never invent prices, hours, or venue facts.'}]},{role:'user',content:[{type:'input_text',text:prompt}]}],temperature:0.2,max_output_tokens:7000}}}];

[{json:{...source,requestBody:undefined,finalCopyRequiredKeys:undefined,finalCopy,finalCopyOk:!reason,finalCopyFailureReason:reason,errorCode:reason? 'FINAL_COPY_GENERATION_FAILED':undefined,rawFinalCopyText:reason?String(raw).slice(0,1200):undefined}}];

const item=$input.first().json||{};if(item.finalCopyOk!==true)return [{json:item}];const c=item.finalCopy;const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);const canonicalItinerary={brochure:{agencyName:item.agencyName,agencyLogoUrl:item.agencyLogoUrl||null,agencyContact:item.agencyContact,tripTitle:item.tripTitle||`Itinerary ${item.destination}`,destination:item.destination,region:item.region||null,country:item.country||'',itineraryMode:item.itineraryMode,durationDays:item.durationDays??null,scopeLabel:item.scopeLabel,startDate:item.startDate||null,endDate:item.endDate||null,travelerCount:item.travelerCount??null,travelerType:item.travelerType||null,paceLevel:item.paceLevel,themes:item.themes||[],destinationType:item.destinationType||'mixed',generatedDate:today,outputLanguage:item.outputLanguage},hero:{photoUrl:null,photoAttribution:null,gradientOnly:true},overview:c.overview,schedule:item.schedule||[],spots:item.spots||[],practical:c.practical,closing:{closingNote:c.closing.closingNote,agencyContact:item.agencyContact,disclaimer:c.closing.disclaimer,photoCredits:[]}};return [{json:{...item,canonicalItinerary,finalCopy:undefined,finalCopyOk:undefined,finalCopyFailureReason:undefined,verifiedVenueSet:item.verifiedVenueSet||[],cpStage:'CP006_CANONICAL_READY'}}];

const item=$input.first().json||{};if(item.ok!==true)return [{json:item}];const override=String(item.heroPhotoUrl||'').trim();const requestMode=override?'override':'search';const candidate=override?{url:override,confidence:1,source:'agent_supplied',downloadLocation:null,attribution:{photographer:'Agent-supplied photo',photographerUrl:override,source:'agent_supplied'}}:null;const query=[item.destination,item.region,item.destinationType,'landscape travel landmark'].filter(Boolean).join(' ');return [{json:{...item,photoRequestMode:requestMode,photoCandidate:candidate,photoQuery:requestMode==='search'?query:null,photoConfidenceThreshold:0.8,photoSearchUrl:'https://api.unsplash.com/search/photos'}}];

const response=$input.first().json||{};const source=$('Build Photo Request').first().json;const messages=Array.isArray(response.output)?response.output.filter(e=>e?.type==='message'):[];const last=messages[messages.length-1];const raw=last?.content?.map(p=>p?.text||p?.content||'').join('')||response.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||'';const strip=v=>String(v||'').trim().replace(/^\`\`\`json\s*/i,'').replace(/^\`\`\`\s*/,'').replace(/\s*\`\`\`$/,'').trim();let parsed=response&&Array.isArray(response.results)?response:null;if(!parsed&&raw){const clean=strip(raw);try{parsed=JSON.parse(clean)}catch(_){const a=clean.indexOf('{'),b=clean.lastIndexOf('}');if(a>=0&&b>a)try{parsed=JSON.parse(clean.slice(a,b+1))}catch(_){}}}const results=Array.isArray(parsed?.results)?parsed.results:[];const eligible=results.map(r=>({url:r?.urls?.regular||r?.url||null,confidence:Number(r?.confidence??r?.score??0),downloadLocation:r?.links?.download_location||r?.download_location||null,attribution:{photographer:r?.user?.name||r?.photographer||'',photographerUrl:r?.user?.links?.html||r?.photographerUrl||'',source:'unsplash'},isVenueLevel:Boolean(r?.isVenueLevel)})).find(r=>r.url&&/^https?:\/\//i.test(r.url)&&r.confidence>=Number(source.photoConfidenceThreshold||0.8)&&r.attribution.photographer&&/^https?:\/\//i.test(r.attribution.photographerUrl)&&!r.isVenueLevel);const photoOk=Boolean(eligible);return [{json:{...source,photoCandidate:eligible||null,photoOk,photoFailureReason:photoOk?undefined:(results.length?'LOW_CONFIDENCE_OR_MISSING_ATTRIBUTION':'PHOTO_SEARCH_FAILED'),rawPhotoText:photoOk?undefined:raw.slice(0,1000)}}];
const item=$input.first().json||{};return [{json:{...item,photoFallback:true,photoCandidate:null,photoOk:false,photoFailureReason:item.photoFailureReason||'GRADIENT_FALLBACK'}}];

const base=$('Build Photo Request').first().json||{};const parsed=base.photoRequestMode==='override'?{}:($('Parse Photo Result').first().json||{});const item={...base,...parsed};const candidate=item.photoRequestMode==='override'?base.photoCandidate:(item.photoFallback?null:parsed.photoCandidate);const hero=candidate?{photoUrl:candidate.url,photoAttribution:candidate.attribution,gradientOnly:false}:{photoUrl:null,photoAttribution:null,gradientOnly:true};const canonical=item.canonicalItinerary?{...item.canonicalItinerary,hero,closing:{...item.canonicalItinerary.closing,photoCredits:candidate?[candidate.attribution]:[]}}:null;return [{json:{...item,canonicalItinerary:canonical,photoUsed:Boolean(candidate),photoFallback:!candidate,photoCandidate:undefined,rawPhotoText:undefined,photoFailureReason:undefined}}];
